{"text": "The function `get_requirements` is a method of the `RequirementCommand` class.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `get_requirements` takes four parameters: `args`, `options`, `finder`, and `session`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The parameter `args` is a list of strings representing direct package requirements.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The parameter `finder` is a `PackageFinder` instance used to locate packages.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The parameter `session` is a `PipSession` used for network operations.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `get_requirements` parses command-line arguments into a list of `InstallRequirement` objects representing Python packages to be installed.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `get_requirements` processes constraints from files, direct command-line arguments, editable installations, and regular requirement files.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `get_requirements` converts each parsed requirement into an `InstallRequirement` object using helper functions such as `install_req_from_parsed_requirement`, `install_req_from_line`, and `install_req_from_editable`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `get_requirements` enables hash checking if any requirement specifies hash options.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `get_requirements` raises a `CommandError` if no requirements are provided.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `CommandError` raised by `get_requirements` prompts the user to specify at least one package.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `get_requirements` returns a list of `InstallRequirement` objects representing all parsed requirements.", "type": "dataflow"}
